notes.title: Quadrant v1.4 - OST and Linux Support!
notes.content:
We're glad to announce a Linux version of Quadrant is now available! Thanks to the Linux testers for helping us find and fix bugs to release this.

In addition to Linux support, the official Quadrant OST is also available for purchase! This OST features nearly 30 tracks from the game, both soundtrack and ambient tracks are included in the soundtrack. The music was a great compliment to the game, but stands on its own as a great piece of musical work!

We're also pleased to announce crouch is now toggle! This is optional, if you prefer to hold down the crouch button, this will still be supported. Along with this update are various bug fixes and improvements to better the experience all that much more.

Thanks to all of our supporters and fans throughout our development, we're truly grateful to have such a supportive community behind our game!

- Quadrant Team

notes.content:
We have add several improvements to the Release branch of Quadrant.

Core Engine upgrade - this has greatly improved performance!
DX11 Support
Added a jog state for the player to go into after running out of sprint. Walk/Jog/Sprint states
Fixed gear not showing up on respawn
Several misc improvements throughout the game

Thank you

notes.title: Chapter 3 Open Beta
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone for the wait and continued support. The Quadrant team has been hard at work making Chapter 3 an epic conclusion to Quadrant. We have decided to release as an open beta a number of days before release to get your feedback. 

You can open the games properties (right click on the game in your library) and select the beta opt in beta channel to enable. Thanks for playing we hope you enjoy. Here are highlight release notes: 

-Chapter 3 featuring new settings and gameplay
-Two endings based on an important decision (no spoiler) from Chapter 2
-Subtitles (optional) added for all Voice Over
- Lots of Chapter 1 and 2 improvements!

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Hello all,

Well, here we are at the end of September and sadly Chapter Two isn't out. We really did try to finish but it's not quite there.

Chapter Two is close and we are putting the final touches on it. 
In addition, we have redone Chapter One monster animations and are adding achievements. 

We apologize for the wait and are working diligently to get it out soon.

Thank you for your support and understanding!

notes.title: Chapter Two Update!
notes.content:
Greetings, 
We just wanted to give everyone a little update on Chapter two. It is coming along very nicely and we've been able to take a lot of feedback and lessons from chapter one and really improve two. 

Some of the improvements:
•	Improved level design
•	New enemies
•	Improved AI
•	New mechanics

The plan is to release Chapter Two in September. 

Thank you all for your support.

notes.title: Version 1.05 (Beta) Update
notes.content:
We have just released a public opt in beta of version 1.05. This update brings controller support to Quadrant. We invite the community to test out this feature, and provide feedback so that we may be able to incorporate it in the release version. There are a number of other small improvements to the first episode included. 

To join the opt in beta, right click your  Quadrant game in your Steam library and select properties, from there select the betas tab, and from the drop down list select beta1. The update should then download automatically. We appreciate your participation.

notes.title: Version 1.02 Update
notes.content:
Thanks for all the additional feedback and support. This release addresses a number of bugs, and adds a few requested features.

Release Notes: 

- Additional Key Bindings 
- Motion blur added as a graphical option (default is off)
- Minor adjustment to level layouts
- Minor tweaks to AI player detection
- Misc collision and bug fixes
- Weapons saved between saves
- Flashlight level increased slightly
- Moved sparking wire in Scene 1 vent out of players path
- Changed the book arrangement in library
- Reduced vent count by .0258% 

Survival Mode Update

We are in the process of preparing Survival Mode. Survival mode will feature new enemy types, unique randomization and multiple arenas.

notes.title: Version 1.01 Update (Day 1)
notes.content:
Thank you all for your support during our launch!

We received great feedback from players and are releasing a small day one patch as a result.

Release Notes:

- Fixed bug where player could get Cafeteria area to not show up (Thank you GameR DyroN!)
- Increased run duration
- Mask fogs up slower, defogs quicker, and only starts to fog up when breathing heavily
- Several texture and collision fixes
- Minor clarification and updates to menu options
